description: Audit an OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect setup against RFC 9700 (OAuth 2.0 Security BCP), RFC 8414 and OIDC Discovery. Give an `authorizeUrl` (the /authorize request your app sends) to check PKCE present and S256, state and its entropy, nonce, PAR, redirect_uri over TLS / loopback / wildcards / fragments, secrets in the URL and scope breadth; and/or a `discoveryDocument` (the openid-configuration or oauth-authorization-server JSON, pasted — nothing is fetched) to check issuer, required fields, HTTPS endpoints, RS256, id_token alg "none", implicit and password grants, PKCE advertised (and "plain"), iss in responses, sender-constrained tokens and PAR. Each failed check carries its severity (must/should) and the RFC section.

authorizeUrl.description: The full /authorize URL with its query string

name: oauth_audit
